summary: Iter218 retest of the iter217 fixes. All requested fixes are verified. (1) phone-config i18n: a new static test passed 54/54 across en/fr/zh/hi/fa. orderSummary is 'Step 4 of 4 · Review & pay' style. Price appears only as '$X/mo' plus 'Due today', with no 'Capabilities'/'Bulk IVR capable' line. paymentPrompt has no price. activated() uses the new 'You're live' copy, Starter has no SIP block and Pro does. hubWelcome has the 4-steps line. Live bot (mock TG :5099): the FA hub shows the new copy. The FA plan flow showed Step 1 → Step 2 → type → area → Step 3 with real numbers → Step 4 'مرحله ۴ از ۴ · بررسی و پرداخت' with one Due-today line. I stopped before paying. (2) Bot custom caller ID errors in FA: emergency, number_taken (seeded number owned by another chat) and plan_required are all translated. plan_required was hit by a downgrade between entry and confirm, and Pro tapping 🎭 gets the Business upsell. The 10-digit '4155550989' normalises to +14155550989. The FA and EN free-trial confirmations say 'Your free test call will show X', with no '(shared)'. On the '📋 recent' path, ivrObData before was {displayCallerId:+14155550989} and after had no displayCallerId. (3) caller-ids downgrade: a new unit test passed 9/9. isVerified/resolve are false after business→pro and when the Business number has expired, and true again after re-upgrade. A SIP default (the voice-service outFrom logic) falls back to the own number. Code-verified numbers still work on Pro. (4) The 10-digit showAs normalises to +14155550199: trycall _showAs 7/7 cases pass, and the /phone/test/caller-id API returns +14155550199. (5) Web: the CallerIds attest copy says 'Business plan feature', and the intro says 'on Business'. SIP defaults list exactly Alice's 4 Business numbers and exclude her 2 Pro numbers. The attest 911 error is shown. (6) Regression: caller-ids attest unit 23/23, reject-retry unit passes, iter217 web pytest 21/21, new showAs pytest 3/3, EN plan flow Steps 1–4 correct. Landing: the cycling word, 3 pickers, 3 tabs with panels, picker scrolls, 7 compare rows, 10 FAQ, #try with the showAs input; no page errors.

minor.issue: Object.assign(ivrObData, preset…) does not delete displayCallerId. Opening the Quick IVR menu keeps the old ivrObData (I saw displayCallerId still set after entering the menu). So a custom caller ID left over from an earlier session can carry into a preset call. This includes the free-trial custom caller ID, which needs no plan. Launch (~27947) passes ivrObData.displayCallerId without checking again. Fix: delete ivrObData.displayCallerId in the preset path. Ideally also re-check Business at launch, or clear displayCallerId when the Quick IVR menu opens.
'📞 68 phone numbers activated this week' is still in English. 'اعداد مجازی' is the Arabic word for 'numbers'; Farsi would use 'شماره‌های مجازی'.

The 10-digit → +1 normalisation is copied in 4 places: trycall call-me inline, trycall _showAs, phone-test-routes, and the _index.js customCidEnter. Extract it into one helper, for example caller-ids clean()/toE164.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bot runbook: sudo supervisorctl stop nodejs; node js/tests/mock_telegram_api.js &; TELEGRAM_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5099 node js/start-bot.js > /tmp/bot218.log &; node js/tests/seed_iter218.js seed. PhoneMonitor suspends the fake seeded numbers about 30 s after start, so run node js/tests/t218_reactivate.js afterwards. Use t218_trial.js <chat…> to mark the free trial as used, so Business chats get the paid Quick IVR path instead of the trial. Drive the bot with BOT_LOG=/tmp/bot218.log node js/tests/say_iter215.js <chat> '<text>'. Clean with t218_cleanextra.js and then seed_iter218.js clean. Finally pkill the bot and the mock and run sudo supervisorctl start nodejs. Web app routes are under /cloudivr/app/* (Numbers page = /cloudivr/app/numbers). Alice has 4 Business and 2 Pro numbers. In dry run, /public/try/* does not persist showAs, so the normaliser is unit-tested via showas_norm_iter218.js.
